title: "POP ICON OF THE GENERATION": Fans react as BTS' Jungkook's 'SEVEN' keeps its crown as most streamed K-soloist song with 2.46 billion Spotify streams - NewsBreak
text: On July 30, 2025, About Music reported that BTS' Jungkook topped the list of most streamed songs by K-soloists on Spotify with his track SEVEN . The K-pop sensation maintained the position with the massive streaming numbers of over 2.46 billion. SEVEN is Jungkook’s collaborative track that he sang with American rapper Latto and released in July 2023. Fans of BTS member Jungkook were pleased with his recent accomplishment. As a result, fans swamped the internet with positive comments about the musician. ​ More fans congratulated Golden maknae for accomplishing this feat with his independent artistry. While many people were proud of the youngest BTS member, others referred to him as the ‘Kingkook.' ​ Some stressed the global impact of BTS' Jungkook, while others labeled him as the legendary K-pop idol. ​ On July 14, 2023, BIGHIT Music released Jungkook's single as the pre-release for his inaugural solo album GOLDEN . The company describes the track in the wording below: ​ The song also emerged as the best-selling K-pop song in the US in 2025.
